import React from 'react'; import { Link } from 'react-router-dom'; import { FaArrowRight } from 'react-icons/fa'; import './PageStyles.css'; const values = [ { icon: '❤️', title: 'Compassion', desc: 'Every child is treated with love and empathy. We provide training and guidance to extend care at home.' }, ]; const team = [ { emoji: '👩‍⚕️', name: 'Dr. Priya Ramesh', role: 'Lead Therapist & Founder' }, { emoji: '👨‍⚕️', name: 'Mr. Arjun Kumar', role: 'Behavior Analyst (BCBA)' }, { emoji: '👩‍🏫', name: 'Ms. Kavitha Nair', role: 'Speech & Language Pathologist' }, { emoji: '👨‍🏫', name: 'Mr. Ravi Subramaniam', role: 'Occupational Therapist' }, ]; export default function AboutUs() { return (
About Us

We Are Tiny Todds Therapy Care

The society today faces many health challenges. Physical and mental disorders that were rare in the past are now spreading rapidly. We are here to help families navigate these challenges with expertise, compassion, and hope.

Get In Touch
🏥
{/* Story */}
Our Story

Built on Hope & Experience

Tiny Todds Therapy Care was founded with a singular vision: to provide every child with autism and developmental disorders the care they deserve. With over 20 years of experience and 22 branches across Tamil Nadu, we have grown into one of the most trusted therapy centers in the region.

Our team of 160+ qualified therapists, educators, and specialists work tirelessly to create personalized intervention plans that empower children and support their families.

We believe that autism is curable — or at least, that with the right support, children with autism can lead fulfilling, independent, and joyful lives.

20+

Years of dedicated service to children with autism and developmental challenges across South India.

22

Active branches across Chennai, Coimbatore, Nagercoil and other cities in Tamil Nadu.

{/* Values */}
Our Values

What We Stand For
